title: WhatsApp health
description: OpenWA status per clinic from local DB. “Ready” is only a recent sync (not the OpenWA admin). Restart/stop do talk to OpenWA.
cache_note: This screen is not live OpenWA. Cron syncs a batch every 5 min. “Ready” requires a sync within {{minutes}} min. If OpenWA shows 2 connected and you see 12 here, those 12 are stale.
rate_limited: OpenWA is in a 429 cooldown. Do not restart sessions until this clears; cron is paused too.
openwa_off: OpenWA is not configured on this instance.
needs_qr_alert_title: Some clinics must scan the QR again
needs_qr_alert: {{count}} session(s) are on QR or disconnected with no phone. Auto-reconnect will not restore them; the clinic must link again.
restart_confirm: Restart WhatsApp for {{name}}? This calls OpenWA.
stop_confirm: Stop WhatsApp for {{name}}? The clinic cannot send until they link again.

empty.title: No problems in view
empty.description: No living clinic matches this filter. Try “All” to see the full list.
empty.listos_description: Only clinics with WhatsApp ready appear here. Check Problems, Disconnected, or Need QR.
